title: Diptych with Targets
description: Framed diptych displayed on a grey wall, each panel dense with collaged fragments, concentric target rings, warplane silhouettes, and scattered mechanical forms on an ivory ground. Red borders frame the right panel, which includes fabric lettering reading 'XXXIIIDIDS' and an american football motif along the lower register.
composition: horizontal diptych, dense all-over collage arrangement
